doc.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019

title: How Caine likes to be recorded
summary: He puts his bass in a corner of the room, using a pickup.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: How do you like to get recorded in the studio?

Well I mean I’m not an expert on mics and stuff, but usually what I do is take my bass — well it depends on how we’re doing it, if I’m isolated or not, but even if I’m not, because once again I use a pick-up, I like to get a corner kind of, and have the bass in the corner. It kind of reverberates the sound. But it depends on the engineer and all that stuff.
